title: Aloo Gosht (Beef and Potato Curry)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A family recipe from the author's mother by way of his brother Tasnim. The potatoes soak up the meat curry; for him it's the dish that most tastes of home.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and fry 5+ min, until light brown:
items: Half of: 2 medium onions (1 lb / 450 g total), quartered and thinly sliced

steps.action: Add and brown on all sides, until the released water has mostly cooked off:
items: 1¾ lb stewing beef (800 g), chuck or round, in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes
2 medium tomatoes (10 oz / 280 g total), in ⅓ in (1 cm) pieces

steps.action: Add, mix, and bring to a boil:
Cover; simmer on medium-low (3/10) 90 min, stirring every 20 min.
Turn to high; stir constantly 2 min, scraping the bottom.
Add and mix; bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on medium-low 30 min:
items: 3 medium potatoes (1 lb / 450 g), peeled, in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes

steps.action: Test a cooled potato piece; if not done, cook 5 min more and repeat.
Mix in; cover and rest 5 min:
items: 3 green chilies (or 1 jalapeño), in thin rings
Plain rice and daal, or bread and daal (author's favorite: bread and Maash ki Sookhi Daal)
No daal needed with a fancy rice
